name: TikTok
label: TikTok — Content Posting / Display / Research API v2
description: TikTok Content Posting API at https://open.tiktokapis.com. Docs: https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/content-posting-api-get-started. direct_post_* send official post_info + source_info (not a flat media blob). creator_info is POST with an empty body. Bearer access_token. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"creator_info"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: creator_info | direct_post_video | direct_post_photo | upload_inbox | publish_status | video_list | insights_get | research_query | trigger.

schema.label: media
schema.description: Upload bytes nested as source_info.media (video) or source_info.photo_images (photo).

schema.label: video_url
schema.description: HTTPS URL nested as source_info.video_url (PULL_FROM_URL) on direct_post_video / upload_inbox.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Caption/title nested as post_info.title on direct_post_video / direct_post_photo / upload_inbox. Max 2200 chars.

schema.label: privacy_level
schema.description: post_info.privacy_level on direct_post_*. EXACT: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR | SELF_ONLY.

schema.label: total_chunk_count
schema.description: FILE_UPLOAD source_info.total_chunk_count. Example: 1.

schema.label: chunk_size
schema.description: FILE_UPLOAD source_info.chunk_size. Example: 10485760.

schema.label: video_size
schema.description: FILE_UPLOAD source_info.video_size bytes. Example: 10485760.

schema.label: photo_cover_index
schema.description: direct_post_photo cover image index. Example: 0.

schema.label: media_type
schema.description: direct_post_photo media_type required. Example: PHOTO.

schema.label: post_mode
schema.description: direct_post_photo post_mode required. Example: DIRECT_POST.

schema.label: source
schema.description: source_info.source for init (PULL_FROM_URL or FILE_UPLOAD). Example: PULL_FROM_URL.

schema.label: publish_id
schema.description: publish_status body. Returned by init.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: video_list query fields. Example: id,title,cover_image_url,create_time.

schema.label: max_count
schema.description: video_list / research_query page size. Display max 20; Research max 100.

schema.label: video_ids
schema.description: Video ids nested as filters.video_ids on insights_get.

schema.label: query
schema.description: research_query condition tree as a JSON string. Academic Research API only.

schema.label: start_date
schema.description: research_query start_date YYYYMMDD.

schema.label: end_date
schema.description: research_query end_date YYYYMMDD.
Dummy body key for creator_info so the engine sends {} instead of the whole input. Leave blank.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: video_list pagination cursor (official body cursor). 0 for the first page.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. trigger is ingress. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (creator, publish_id, videos, research). Do not log upload_url query tokens.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: User token (act.) for posting/display, or Research client token (clt.) for research_query. StudioQuack secret. Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Source
configurationParameters.description: source_info.source for init (PULL_FROM_URL or FILE_UPLOAD). Example: PULL_FROM_URL.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Example: 30.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
